title: 1.5M-6M Electric-Sunshade outdoor canopy retractable umbrella folding telescopic hand rain proof canopy电动伸缩遮阳帘
description:
1.5M-6M Electric-Sunshade outdoor canopy retractable umbrella folding telescopic hand rain proof canopy电动伸缩遮阳帘
Product name: awning
Material: Polyester
Bracket material: aluminum alloy
Waterproof index: greater than 3000mm
Function: foldable/manual telescopic/electric telescopic
Product includes: awning + hand crank (if you need a motor, please purchase additionally)

1: Remarks: color number+estimated installation height (you can also leave a message directly to the customer service)
2: Choose the size you need
3: If you need a motor, please purchase the option of the motor, otherwise the goods are delivered manually

Note that the package contains cloth and fabric Please use the knowledge carefully when disassembling the package to avoid damaging the cloth inside

Note: Since the motor is wrapped in the steel pipe, it is difficult to treat heat, so it cannot run continuously for more than 2 minutes Once the motor is exceeded, it will automatically start the protection mode and stop working Please wait for the motor to cool down before restarting (no less than about 50 minutes)
